evidence: Every refuse/hide/absent/unchanged leg in the shipped criteria carries a same-kind positive control inside the same criterion, and functional/prompt.md:13 adds a global rule: 'Every refusal row needs its own positive control: a successful action of the same kind, observed in this review.' prompt.md:17 further requires role replays to use a fresh legal request whose identical Rafael request is the control, and excludes stale/duplicate/skip/full refusals from counting as the role refusal. Pairings (tests/scored/functional/judge.toml): hro_job_open:29 ('the successful opening is the control'); hro_add_email_rules:47 (other-job accept 'the control'); hro_move_one_stage:56 (skip refused + one-stage forward/back must work); hro_reject_reason:83 (blank refused + reasoned reject); hro_reject_hired:92 ('A rejection of a non-hired card is the control'); hro_reopen:101 (reopen elsewhere refused + own-stage reopen + undo restores reason); hro_interview_full:110 ('the two cards that entered Interview are the control'); hro_undo_full:128 (same undo with room goes ahead); hro_mgr_early_refused:155 ('their late-stage moves are the control'); hro_mgr_other_job:164; hro_observer_readonly:173 and hro_candidate_no_staff:182 (Rafael's identical successful requests; candidate session-control; 'A candidate who cannot sign in ... makes this row 0'); hro_anonymous:191 ('A signed-in success of each is the control'); hro_refusal_status:200 ('If none of these replays was refused, this row is 0'); hro_stale_refused:209; hro_bulk_all_or_none:227; hro_bulk_places:236; hro_undo_conflict:254 (unrelated-change undo goes ahead); hro_undo_once:263; hro_activity_refusals:281 ('The successful actions' lines are the control'); hro_notes:290 (Recruiter + own-manager notes and Observer read); hro_msg_compose:317 (blank refused + normal send); hro_unread_scrolled_up:353 (place not moved + notice + later read); hro_seen:362 (not seen early + seen after Tomas/Bill/Rafael); hro_thread_access:371 (Rafael read/send controls, Bill/Mei write); hro_candidate_private:398 ('A candidate page that receives none of its own data is 0', Rafael's identical read succeeded); hro_restart:416 (no reseed + data unchanged). Polish (tests/scored/polish/judge.toml): hro_pol_live_board:23 and hro_pol_live_thread:32 'If no update arrives within 15 seconds, preservation cannot be shown and this row is 0'; hro_pol_failed_send:50 (resend sent once); hro_pol_session_resume:59 (explicit positive control; Mei's empty boxes paired with Rafael's drafts surviving). Gates: render:23 pairs wrong-password refusal with Recruiter sign-in to a usable workspace; constraints:23 requires a real cross-context create. The global gate at prompt.md:11-13 zeroes every binary criterion for a blank/static/no-op app. Broken-app probes (source reasoning): (1) app that refuses every write: global gate fails, all functional binaries 0; (2) app whose roles return 403 for everything, including staff: Rafael controls fail in observer/candidate/anonymous rows, and C's stale replay returns 403 not 409 so hro_refusal_status fails; (3) app that offers managers no moves: hro_mgr_early_refused loses its late-stage control; (4) app without live push: polish preservation rows are explicitly 0; (5) app with no conversations: hro_thread_access/candidate_private lose their read/send controls. Conforming alternative probe: an app that hides refused controls or blocks client-side passes because hiding is optional and prompt.md:23 replays the captured successful request. Minor wording notes (not defects): hro_activity_refusals:281 and hro_mgr_early_refused:155 name the control without a dedicated 'Fails if the control did not succeed' clause; the shared prompt.md:13/17 rule supplies it, and for open-job/add-candidate the same-kind control is Rafael's S-protocol success, though line 155 names only late-stage moves. Template alignment: template functional prompt requires 'A positive control must come before every negative claim'; the task keeps that intent. Runtime: raw-evidence-index scope states configured grading and reward discrimination are absent; the scripted golden run (workspace.json sha 47c2e8ef...) does not test broken apps. So whether the judge actually zeroes a dead app is NOT EXERCISED. That is owned by the runtime discrimination records and does not change this design-level verdict.
